metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-85046: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.. Product: Chromium V8
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-85046" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-85046" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-85046" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-REMOTE-CODE-EXECUTION-011
